info.title: IDEA · Development API
info.description: Current implemented HTTP adapters plus reviewed semantic trace. No deployment claim. Existing credential operations remain documentation-only; all newly catalogued Feature 009 operations are documentation-only here so this document repair does not enable a new Swagger mutation surface.

x-idea-contract.authority: Public operational liveness/readiness; no identity authority
x-idea-contract.state: Process liveness (not database readiness)
x-idea-contract.atomicity: Observation only, no business success.
x-idea-contract.concurrency: Public process observation; no account/session/security-version or credential-proof check; not a transaction outcome.
x-idea-contract.retry: Read-only current observation; safe to repeat, never replay a mutation.

x-idea-contract.authority: Public operational liveness/readiness; no identity authority
x-idea-contract.state: Actual PostgreSQL readiness
x-idea-contract.atomicity: Observation only, no business success.
x-idea-contract.concurrency: Public database observation at request time; a later operation may observe a different state; no credential proof or eligible-session prerequisite.
x-idea-contract.retry: Read-only current observation; safe to repeat, never replay a mutation.

get.summary: JSON CSRF acquisition (automatic in this console)

200.description: headerName and token; retain in memory only

x-idea-contract.authority: Public session-backed CSRF acquisition
x-idea-contract.state: JSON CSRF acquisition (automatic in this console)
x-idea-contract.atomicity: Observation only, no business success.
x-idea-contract.concurrency: Session-backed CSRF acquisition, including anonymous acquisition. This token is not a one-use credential setup/reset proof.
x-idea-contract.retry: Read-only current observation; safe to repeat, never replay a mutation.

post.summary: Sign in through IDEA Web, not Swagger
post.description: Session-backed CSRF is required even for login. Generic refusal covers invalid/disabled/blocked credentials. Successful login rotates servlet proof; Actor is determined by Server. Use the existing Web password control, not an API-console body or generated curl.

401.description: Generic authentication refusal, including unavailable identity verification handled by the sign-in filter

403.description: CSRF refusal

x-idea-contract.authority: Native credential verification + CSRF; generic refusal; server-derived Actor
x-idea-contract.state: Session-backed CSRF is required even for login. Generic refusal covers invalid/disabled/blocked credentials. Successful login rotates servlet proof; Actor is determined by Server. Use the existing Web password control, not an API-console body or generated curl.
x-idea-contract.atomicity: Qualified IAM transaction fate; required IAM outcome/Audit and state change commit or rollback together.
x-idea-contract.concurrency: Qualified verifier work plus durable throttle/security state in the login transaction; session fixation protection rotates the ordinary servlet proof on success.
x-idea-contract.retry: Read-only current observation; safe to repeat, never replay a mutation.

401.description: Anonymous, expired, revoked, stale, disabled or unavailable identity verification

x-idea-contract.authority: Eligible Server session; account mutations require matching explicit Account Administrator Permission and Organization Scope; POST requires CSRF.
x-idea-contract.state: Read the eligible Server-derived identity
x-idea-contract.atomicity: Observation only, no business success.
x-idea-contract.concurrency: Current session/account/runtime/security-version eligibility; observation is not permission for a later owner commit.
x-idea-contract.retry: Read-only current observation; safe to repeat, never replay a mutation.

post.summary: Sign out this eligible session only
post.description: No body. Automatic CSRF header; eligible session required. Success revokes only the current session. Failure does not claim logout success.

401.description: Session is not eligible

403.description: CSRF refusal

503.description: Required persistence failed; no successful logout

x-idea-contract.authority: Eligible Server session; account mutations require matching explicit Account Administrator Permission and Organization Scope; POST requires CSRF.
x-idea-contract.state: No body. Automatic CSRF header; eligible session required. Success revokes only the current session. Failure does not claim logout success.
x-idea-contract.atomicity: Qualified IAM transaction fate; required IAM outcome/Audit and state change commit or rollback together.
x-idea-contract.concurrency: Eligibility is rechecked under security-write coordination before current-session revocation and accepted evidence commit.
x-idea-contract.retry: Read-only current observation; safe to repeat, never replay a mutation.

post.summary: Create a pending account (explicit Account Administrator required)
post.description: Exact Organization Scope and role assignment are required. Super Administrator alone cannot create accounts. Does not grant project/group/product access or activate credentials.

400.description: Invalid input

401.description: Ineligible session

403.description: Missing permission/wrong scope or CSRF refusal

409.description: Login identifier exists or invalid account state

x-idea-contract.authority: Eligible Server session; account mutations require matching explicit Account Administrator Permission and Organization Scope; POST requires CSRF.
x-idea-contract.state: Exact Organization Scope and role assignment are required. Super Administrator alone cannot create accounts. Does not grant project/group/product access or activate credentials.
x-idea-contract.atomicity: Qualified IAM transaction fate; required IAM outcome/Audit and state change commit or rollback together.
x-idea-contract.concurrency: Current exact scoped account-create authority and owner validation at authoritative commit; no implicit role or project entitlement.
x-idea-contract.retry: operationId is attribution, not universal idempotency. Do not blindly replay create or disclose/recreate proofs. Inspect current state after lost response; reset/setup redemption cannot be reused.

400.description: Invalid input

401.description: Ineligible session

403.description: Permission/scope/last-Super or CSRF refusal

x-idea-contract.atomicity: Qualified IAM transaction fate; required IAM outcome/Audit and state change commit or rollback together.

x-idea-contract.retry: operationId is attribution, not universal idempotency. Do not blindly replay create or disclose/recreate proofs. Inspect current state after lost response; reset/setup redemption cannot be reused.

post.summary: Re-enable separately from password recovery; fresh login required

200.description: ACTIVE if credential exists, otherwise PENDING; old sessions remain invalid

400.description: Invalid input

401.description: Ineligible session

403.description: Permission/scope or CSRF refusal

x-idea-contract.authority: Eligible Server session; account mutations require matching explicit Account Administrator Permission and Organization Scope; POST requires CSRF.
x-idea-contract.state: DISABLED -> ACTIVE if a credential exists, otherwise PENDING; fresh sign-in required.
x-idea-contract.atomicity: Qualified IAM transaction fate; required IAM outcome/Audit and state change commit or rollback together.
x-idea-contract.concurrency: Expected account security version and current authority rechecked; enablement is separate from credential recovery.
x-idea-contract.retry: operationId is attribution, not universal idempotency. Do not blindly replay create or disclose/recreate proofs. Inspect current state after lost response; reset/setup redemption cannot be reused.

post.summary: Issue setup/reset proof through an explicitly enabled delivery mode (documentation-only)
post.description: Separate setup/reset Permissions (supported AA@2/AA@3), eligible scoped issuer. RESET requires exact loginIdentityId and ACTIVE or DISABLED target. Manual delivery requires exact loginIdentityId for either purpose. One-use expiring proof; transient private handoff only; no guaranteed delivery/deployment claim.

200.description: Target-bound one-use expiring proof; private handoff only, no-store; no logging or retained credential examples.

400.description: Invalid input

401.description: Ineligible session

403.description: Permission/scope or CSRF refusal

409.description: Stale version or invalid target/credential state

503.description: Delivery mode is disabled or required persistence/delivery failed; do not report proof delivery success.

x-idea-contract.authority: Independent setup/reset Permission at exact Organization Scope + eligible session + CSRF
x-idea-contract.state: FIRST_SETUP appropriate PENDING target; RESET ACTIVE or DISABLED, exact Login Identity and expected security version. Manual delivery requires exact loginIdentityId for both purposes.
x-idea-contract.atomicity: Qualified IAM transaction fate; required IAM outcome/Audit and state change commit or rollback together.
x-idea-contract.concurrency: Exact purpose/target/version and current scoped issuance authority at commit; target-bound, one-use, expiring proof; same-purpose supersession only.
x-idea-contract.retry: operationId is attribution, not universal idempotency. Do not blindly replay create or disclose/recreate proofs. Inspect current state after lost response; reset/setup redemption cannot be reused.

post.summary: Redeem through the official credential flow, not Swagger
post.description: Proof authorizes the exact target, not an administrator role. CSRF still required. Reset changes only the pinned Login Identity credential, increases Account security version and invalidates old sessions/proofs; it cannot re-enable a disabled account.

400.description: Invalid/stale/expired/used proof or password/input refusal

403.description: CSRF refusal

x-idea-contract.authority: Exact target-bound one-use expiring proof + CSRF; no administrator role required
x-idea-contract.state: Reset preserves DISABLED and actor disabled_at; old Account sessions/proofs invalidate.
x-idea-contract.atomicity: Qualified IAM transaction fate; required IAM outcome/Audit and state change commit or rollback together.
x-idea-contract.concurrency: Proof purpose/target/version/expiry/use status atomically checked; concurrent redemption cannot consume the proof twice.
x-idea-contract.retry: operationId is attribution, not universal idempotency. Do not blindly replay create or disclose/recreate proofs. Inspect current state after lost response; reset/setup redemption cannot be reused.
